# WATAM DeFi Intelligence

> Independent liquidity data for token teams, exchanges and market makers: every order book of a token on 23 exchanges and its on-chain DEX pools, every five minutes, verified on chain, history kept. Also on-chain DEX analytics for protocol and token teams, exchange listing and risk teams and funds. Swaps are decoded
> directly from the chain on Ethereum, Arbitrum One, OP Mainnet, Base, BNB Smart Chain, Avalanche C-Chain, Monad, Solana
> and TON. Every anomaly finding carries an Evidence Card that answers five questions: what was observed; where the
> evidence is (network, blocks, pools, transactions); how it was computed (method, frozen baseline); how much it can be
> trusted (coverage, gaps, checks, caveats); and how to check it independently (detection SQL with its hash and an
> eth_getLogs recipe for any public node). Independent analytics by WATAM Intelligence (We Are The Art Makers); not
> affiliated with the projects or exchanges listed. USD values are not part of the evidence.

Evidence Cards cover anomaly findings on the EVM networks. Solana and TON entries have coverage and verified swaps, but
no anomaly findings yet. Findings describe the verified pools that were measured, never a token's whole market, and none
is an accusation.

## Product
- [Overview](https://defi.wearetheartmakers.com/): what a finding contains, the nine networks, how the pipeline works
- [Token catalog](https://defi.wearetheartmakers.com/tokens/): every tracked token with status, coverage window, verified swaps, pools and anomaly findings
- [Live Pro](https://defi.wearetheartmakers.com/live-pro/): per-token add-on, sales-led; six checks (large trade, volume burst, trading went quiet, one-sided flow, one address dominates, pool liquidity drop) on a token's verified EVM pools read from confirmed blocks about every 5 minutes; pre-alerts by email, Telegram or webhook, each later checked against verified data (confirmed, or not confirmed with the difference); statistical observations, not claims of intent, not investment advice
- [Exit Check](https://defi.wearetheartmakers.com/exit-check/): free tool; enter a network, a token and an amount and see the value a wallet displays (amount x last price) next to what live aggregator sell quotes would pay out (KyberSwap and Velora on EVM networks; Jupiter and Raydium on Solana), the shortfall, the route and, for catalog tokens, our verified DEX exit depth at -2/-5/-10 %; quotes are indicative, informational, not investment advice; [open the tool](https://app.wearetheartmakers.com/exit-check)
- [Pricing](https://defi.wearetheartmakers.com/pricing/): Token USD 490, Pro USD 990, Data USD 2,500, Enterprise from USD 5,000 per month (annual = 10x); founder pilot USD 149 for 30 days until 30 Nov 2026; Listing Liquidity Dossier USD 750 per token, one-off; bought online, stablecoin or bank transfer
- [Buy online](https://app.wearetheartmakers.com/checkout): self-serve checkout
- [Application](https://app.wearetheartmakers.com/)

## Data (machine-readable)
- [Public catalog API (JSON)](https://app.wearetheartmakers.com/api/public/catalog): tracked tokens with network, contract address, status, history window, verified swaps, pools and findings counts; EVM refreshed every 12 h, TON every 3 h, Solana hourly
- [Full summary with the token list](https://defi.wearetheartmakers.com/llms-full.txt)
- [Sitemap](https://defi.wearetheartmakers.com/sitemap.xml)

## Method
- [Method](https://defi.wearetheartmakers.com/method/): how swaps are collected and verified, the five evidence questions, coverage, limitations and how to reproduce a finding
- [Case study: ZORA on Base](https://defi.wearetheartmakers.com/case-studies/zora-base/): one week of verified swaps and five events; one finding re-run on a public Base node with the same 156 swaps and value
- [Research: the 29 Oct 2026 "Binance 14" outflow on DEX pools](https://defi.wearetheartmakers.com/research/binance-14-outflow-2026-10-29/): block-by-block pool prices, 13 of 14 tracked tokens sold into Uniswap pools, how to reproduce
- [Market reality: ENA on Ethereum](https://defi.wearetheartmakers.com/research/market-reality-ena/): how much real on-chain market a token has — depth at −2/−5/−10 %, organic vs. bot-like activity, liquidity providers, pool map with trust labels, coverage; every number reproducible
- [Public repository](https://github.com/WeAreTheArtMakers/defi-intelligence): overview and reviewed historical examples
